title: Mysterious UFO-like disk that is seen in New Mexico on Google Maps Sparks Investigation
text:
A mysterious structure in a mountainous region in New Mexico has conquered the internet, causing speculation of a UFO crash site.
Google Map users saw a large, white disk that spoke out of the ground at an altitude of 7,400 feet. The coordinates are 34 ° 24’21.6 “N 107 ° 05’44.5” w.
The location, about 34 miles from the National Refuge in Sevilleta in La Joay, is located in the Sierra Ladrones without clear roads or houses nearby.
Google Map images of the site show the top of the disk with metal hardware and part of one side has since been covered by vegetation.
Users have flooded the comments with the speculation, it may be ‘a UFO that has been submitted in this mountain for centuries or a’ ceiling hatch from an underground pendant for a UAP (non -Geidified deviating phenomena). ‘
Others claimed that they saw windows, a hull and electrical circuits on the object.
Some Google Map users have looked back at historical images of the area and finding a black, box-shaped structure in the same place in 1975.
A look ahead and the white disk appeared in 2003.

The Google Map images were shared by X -user StepH Kent He posted: “Something in the form of a disc embedded in a mountain in New Mexico, USA, at an altitude of 2,255 meters.”
Commentators suggested that it could be an observatory, old water reservoir or a crash outside craft.
The earliest Google image, in 1996, unveiled a completely bald landscape without a garbage path or the disk.
Youtuber mrmbb333 Share a video in August while investigating the site on Google Maps.
“This is a very remote location, nothing wrong here,” he said in the clip.
‘This is very similar to a disk that is stuck at the top of this mountain. I measured the disk from left to right, which is about 30 feet left. ‘
He claimed that “when the crash landed in the mountains,” it shot forward and was buried in the ground.
While the theory of the YouTuber suggested that the object was a crash UFO, a user of Mick West’s Metabunk website Had a more realistic investigation.
The post initially claimed that the object was a crashed disk when the user started the thread last August, but they later updated it to read: “The structure has been identified as a rainwater that has since been removed and replaced by another structure.”
They searched through historical records about the US Geological Survey and discovered images from 1975 that showed a black dot where the white disk is now.
There is also a clear path that leads from a clear to the site.

An image from 2013 shows that the disk has not yet been overgrown by vegetation, but has suffered some damage
“So what’s it? A kind of research station? Something related to the nearby test range, “they asked in the post of 26 August.
‘Some suggested a natural tank (which looks comparable, if not a little smaller) or a Frank Lloyd Wright project (it is not).
Wright was an American architect famous for unusually designed houses, some of which were circular.
‘From a quick search, a structure seems to have been built on that exact location of at least 1975, so it seems unlikely that something coincidentally’ crashed ‘,’ the Metabunk user has shared.
Google Map users have encountered many strange locations worldwide with a recent in Los Angeles when people saw ‘help’ set out with different materials on a plot of storage or waste facility in Los Angeles, California.

This area is about a mile east of the town hall of Los Angeles, located between the Los Angeles River, North Mission Road and E Cesar e Chavez Avenue. The coordinates are 34 ° 03’18’n 118 ° 13’30’w.
The Spanish words ‘Traffico’ (traffic) and ‘Terrorismo’ (terrorism) also appear, as well as ‘LAPD’, ‘Federal’ and ‘FBI’.
The images went viral on social media during the weekend, so that the fear was fueled that someone might try to warn the public or law enforcement of a human trafficking in the area.
One reddit user wrote: ‘This sounds like someone or a group is being traded and uses material that is available to them to spell an SOS. I hope that if any person has noticed it, the authorities have noticed it. ‘
“We all know for a long time that sea containers are being used for human trafficking,” placed an X user, who refers to the vicinity of the location to the shipping yard.
Passed viewers also pointed to some gaps or tunnel corridors in the neighborhood, which speculates that nefarious activity can take place inside.
Such a person, who goes ‘Laguy’ on X, spoke with a woman who experiences homelessness who lives near the party.
She told him that the words were written by a man named Jose who she has been writing for years.
“(José’s) The one who always places (help),” she said. “He writes it everywhere (…), it has been years,” she added, although she made it clear that she didn’t know he wrote the messages.
Others who claimed to live in the neighborhood offered similar explanations.
